rounding.note: board pays are exact at every legal bet: no rounding effect on the base game

doubleOrNothing.basicDefinition: the CR's "ordinary blackjack basic strategy" = the conventional no-doubling chart (strategy.js convMask: hard 12 stand against 4-6 else hit; hard 13-16 stand against 2-6 else hit; soft 17 hit; soft 18 stand against 2-8, hit against 9, 10, A); it reproduces the CR's 99.8981% (dealer hits soft 17) and 100.0721% (stands)

otherBasic.note: the rules sheet's basic play is a BOARD strategy (hard 12-16, soft 17); applied to this hand with soft 18 = stand it returns less

doubleOrNothing.note: a win pays exactly 2 x the stake (whole cents), so there is no rounding at any stake. The dealer STANDS on all 17s (build of 16 Oct 2026); win chance per resolved hand p = 0.50045487064506489

policiesExact.note: paths cut below eps are valued with the linear tail model (alpha x banked + beta x held, an estimate); rtpLower values cut paths at 0 (rigorous); the upper bound is rtpLower + lambdaHat x cutTotalX with lambdaHat >= V*/(S+B) over all states (bar_optimum.cpp; aggregate.js), because a double now returns more than 100% and cashing out no longer bounds every policy
policiesExact.upperRule: rtpLower + Lambda x cutTotalX, Lambda = 1.0613 (state-wise max of V*/(S+B), power law in the room 500 x largest ammo = 1.00e+6)

p4Investigation.previousRuns: run-bar v168 (RUN IT AGAIN and RUN HALF in the bar, minimum $1.00): the first 200,000 rounds at $10 (crypto 2401, 2402) gave 96.38% [94.53%, 98.23%], above the exact 94.235%; 600,000 rounds 95.57% [94.18%, 96.95%], exact inside. Run-bar v169 (same bar, minimum $0.02): $10 600,000 rounds 96.516% [94.328%, 98.704%], exact 94.233% below the CI; $100 100,000 rounds 91.605% [89.444%, 93.766%], exact 94.259% above the CI; follow-up seeds: $10 400,000 rounds 95.241% [93.119%, 97.364%] inside, $100 500,000 rounds 93.986% [92.535%, 95.437%] inside; $10 on all 1,000,000 rounds 96.006% [94.443%, 97.569%], exact 94.233% still below (the one failed check of that run; source: minrun/v169_blackjack_out)
p4Investigation.bound: NOT any more "no run-bar policy can beat P0": a double returns 100.091% (p = 0.500455 per resolved hand), so cashing out (P0 94.368%) bounds nothing; P4 itself returns 94.482%, P3 95.230%. The best any bar policy can return is the exact optimum over all policies (bar_optimum.cpp): 97.49% at most for the whole round (lambdaHat x the base return). A P4 sample is judged against its exact value and against that ceiling

heavyTail.note: P4 pays still reach hundreds of x (model Monte Carlo max 4032x at $10, model SD 2.89x v the recursion's 2.69x with its cut paths valued by the tail model): a sample holds few of the largest pays

p4Investigation.hitVsGame: $1: model 49.670% v game 49.532% (200,000 rounds), 1.2 SE apart; $10: model 49.685% v game 49.581% (600,000 rounds), 1.6 SE apart; $100: model 49.667% v game 49.664% (100,000 rounds), 0.0 SE apart

doubleSim.method: runGame(stake) of the shipped build through harness.js, one resolved hand per call (pushes are dealt again inside the call: RUN.deal counts the deals); HIT / STAND asked of a bot: opt = exact best play (rungame.js), conv = the conventional chart (the CR's basic strategy)

monotone.note: lambda(A) rises with A on the whole (1/A law) but is not strictly monotone: lattice effects of the whole-cent halves and the 2-cent minimum move it by a few 1e-5

extrapolation.errorRule: max(spread of the A >= 40 fits and Richardson pairs, 2 x the largest fit RMS residual, 3e-5)
extrapolation.assumption: the error of lambda(A) is a smooth 1/A law plus lattice noise of about the size of the fit residual; the continuum limit has no analytic check here

lambdaHat.note: lambdaHat = max(largest V*(A)/A solved, extrapolated limit + error)

powerLaw.rule: max over all states of V*/(S+B) = exp(intercept) x room^slope, room = cap / (S + B) at the maximising state (S + B = 2 cents)

jointOptimisation.statement: E[V*(ammo)] <= lambdaHat x E[ammo] for ANY base policy, and E[ammo] = the base RTP, maximal (94.368%) at best play; so the optimum over base play AND bar play lies between the best-play exact sum and lambdaHat x 94.368%

maxWinClip.note: MAX WIN = the run cap (an ammo of 20 x the bet: MAX WIN 20,000 x bet = 1,000 x ammo): the offers that would pass MAX WIN disappear

offersCheckVsRunBarV170.compared: round ends (MAX WIN clip, run cap) / DOUBLE OR NOTHING offered / DOUBLE HALF offered / half / keep: bar_optimum.cpp offers() vs RunBar.compute() of run-bar v170

smallAmounts.note: the minimum for DOUBLE OR NOTHING / DOUBLE HALF is $0.02 (a half link needs half >= $0.02). Doubles are exact (a win pays exactly 2 x the stake), so small amounts have no rounding effect; the only small-amount rule is the minimum itself

p5ClosedForm.text: DOUBLE HALF once: a first win of a cents (half = floor(a/2), keep = a - half; half >= 2 cents): pay keep + 2 x half with chance w, keep with chance 1 - w; E = a + (2w - 1) half; RTP(P5) = RTP(P0) + (2w - 1) E[half x 1(half >= 2c)] / bet; every round that wins pays something (hit rate = the board hit rate); w = the DOUBLE OR NOTHING win chance
